definitions.gloss: getting on and off; boarding and alighting
definitions.explanation: The act of getting on and off vehicles such as trains, buses, or cars. Used for the combined action of boarding and disembarking.

examples.japanese: {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧。
⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful when getting on and off the bus.

examples.japanese: お⟦{年寄|としよ}り→年寄り：03460_toshiyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{手伝|てつだ}い→お手伝い：07775_otetsudai⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I helped an elderly person getting on and off.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{段差|だんさ}→段差：14742_dansa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{車椅子|くるまいす}→車椅子：10533_kurumaisu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗|の}り{降|お}りがしやすい。
examples.english: This station has no steps, making it easy to board and alight in a wheelchair.

notes:
Refers specifically to the combined action of getting on and off vehicles. Used as a compound noun from ⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧ (to ride/board) + ⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧ (to get off/alight).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: frequent boarding and alighting
- {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧: easy to get on and off
- {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧: convenient for boarding and alighting
- {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: free to get on and off (unlimited rides)

USAGE:
Often appears on signs and announcements at train stations and bus stops. The phrase {乗|の}り{降|お}り⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧ is commonly used for day passes or unlimited-ride tickets.
